svg.title: Durable run sequence: Session, RunStore, Provider and Scheduler
svg.desc: Sequence diagram of one durable run. The host caller calls Session.run or resume; the Session creates or loads the run and an initial checkpoint in the RunStore. Each turn it checkpoints provider_pending, streams the ProviderRequest and receives normalized events. For tool calls it commits tool_executing with pending events, has the Scheduler resolve, authorize and execute tools, then appends tool results and a checkpoint. For a terminal candidate it dispatches TurnStopping and appends the result with a completed checkpoint. A typed event stream goes back to the caller.
